_note: Enemy variety (D495, D560, D652): sizes and elites per kind, the shield-bearer. Read by Scripts/Gameplay/EnemyVariety.gd. A bigger enemy is its own kind with its own art, and those kinds are the elites (D652): no scaled 'large', no outline. XP stays 1.0: the D297 curve puts level 5 on the last City Gates kill with 15 XP to spare.

levels._note: D642: a fight's enemy_level (RoomEnemySpawner) is the level the hero reaches it at; health[level - 1] and damage[level - 1] multiply the enemy's HP and damage. They follow the SKILLS hero of verify_difficulty: HP with his weapon hits and skills, damage with his HP and armour (the City gear lands at level 5). XP does not grow (D297).

scaling._note: D840 (partial, Sapega: «скейл мобів не великий, але має бути»): effective level = room level + zone_offsets[room scene] + offsets[kind] + floor(max(0, hero level - room level) x EnemyScaling.HERO_LEAD_SHARE 0.5), at most XPManager.MAX_LEVEL (EnemyScaling.scaled_level). The room level of an ordinary enemy or an elite is its fight's enemy_level (D670); a boss's is boss_levels, the level its numbers were made for (Brass Collector and Scorpicore 5, D671/D678; Fire Djinn 12, D671; Mercenary 16, D661), and a boss has no zone offset (its own level is its edge). zone_offsets (Sapega: «є зони, які з самого початку складніші для рівня героя»), by room scene name (as in locations.json), every other room 0: the Laboratory +1 (the late zone Sapega named), the Bandit Camp +1 (an optional side path with a hard group fight and its elite heavy archer, D582/D719); the old ruins get +2 when they are built (world_structure_plan, an optional loop behind the bandit leader's key). HP and damage follow the effective level through levels.health / levels.damage (a boss: their ratio to its floor). XP does not follow the level (D670), so the route levels up as before (verify_xp_curve). Recomputed on every spawn, so a D492 respawn rescales.

pressure._note: D642: how many enemies may wind up at once (EnemyLogic attack token, D576 had 2, D642 3). D770: 2 again, and all from one side of the hero: enemies now arrive fast and stand on both sides.

elite._note: D560's multipliers, only for kinds with "elite": true (D652). D754, D777: poise multiplies the kind's poise (x2.0: elites have a big poise bar), and an elite is not pushed by the hero's hits, like a boss (B134). D829: scale grows every elite from its feet on top of its scene size (D766), so it reads apart from its ordinary kind; D842: x1.5, x1.25 did not read in the playtest.

kinds._note: A kind spawns once its sheet exists (EnemyVariety.available). sizes: weights of the seeded roll in ordinary fights (RoomEnemySpawner.respawns); story fights take medium. A big kind (base = the ordinary kind it stands in for) has no art yet: its spawn point (EnemySpawnPoint.big_kind, a node named BigSlot_*) spawns the base kind until the sheet lands; then the kind needs its scene and Resources/Enemies/enemy_stats_<kind>.tres (verify_enemy_variety checks). foam: the cursed foam effect at the mouth (D653), frame pixels from the frame centre, facing right (jackal_cursed: its own 96x72 frames, the jaws of idle, walk and the bite). scale (B187, D-new): the kind grows from its feet by this before its size and elite.scale, so every adult human enemy stands at the chart's 96 art = 144 world px (design/world_scale.json npc_adult; idle frames, HitAreas): bandit and shield-bearer 73.5 x1.96, brute 98.9 x1.46, tower guard 97.2 x1.48, archers already 144. Beasts have no chart row (monster) and stay x1.0.

stamina._note: D824 (design/enemy_stamina_plan.md): an enemy's stamina, read by Scripts/Gameplay/Components/EnemyStamina.gd. Costs are paid at the strike: swing (each blow of a series, an archer's shot, a flier's dive or bite), lunge (D768), pounce (the jackal's leap and latch, D769). It refills at regen/s once delay s pass without an attack. An enemy that cannot pay its next opener keeps its distance; the blow that empties the bar ends the series and leaves it winded (stands, stun tint, its stagger pose) for winded s; it opens again at recover_at of max. A kind without a row takes its base kind's (elites) and then default. Elites: max x elite.max. Bosses: their own pool, costs per move kind (combo per blow), no refill while fighting: once empty, after the move's own recovery (D316) the boss is winded and then full again, so the pattern (D577) is never skipped or reordered; drink (D564) refills.
